name: gsheets-mcp MCP server

runtime.help_excerpt: Google Sheets tools for tab listing, range reads/writes, search, sheet creation/copying, range clearing, and range touch/recalc.

description: FastMCP stdio server; no application version, resources, prompts, or capability document.

name: gsheets-mcp
description: Installed command immediately enters the MCP stdio loop; no help, version, or explicit serve/capabilities command.

name: python run_server.py
description: Redundant source-tree MCP launcher that mutates sys.path and imports the generic src package.

name: scripts/mcp_lint.py
description: Developer-only AST linter; current rules do not detect JSON-string outputs, error-as-success, schema quality, or several mutating verbs.

name: gsheet_list_tabs
description: Lists tab metadata. Input/output spreadsheet vocabulary differs and tab fields mix casing.

name: gsheet_read_range

runtime.help_excerpt: input: spreadsheet, cell_range, value_render_option, date_time_render_option; outputSchema: result:string

description: Reads a range. Render enums and field examples are absent from schema; output teaches spreadsheet_id/range instead of the input keys.

name: gsheet_update_range

runtime.help_excerpt: input: spreadsheet, cell_range, values; outputSchema: result:string

description: Overwrites cells with an unconstrained two-dimensional array and returns camelCase fields inside a JSON string.

name: gsheet_append_rows

runtime.help_excerpt: input: spreadsheet, cell_range, values; outputSchema: result:string

description: Non-idempotent append with no annotation or uncertain-outcome guidance.

name: gsheet_create
description: Non-idempotent spreadsheet creation with no title bounds, duplicate semantics, or uncertain-outcome guidance.

name: gsheet_copy_spreadsheet

runtime.help_excerpt: input: source, new_title, tabs; outputSchema: result:string

description: Multi-stage non-idempotent copy; partial destination/progress is lost on failure and input/output names conflict.

name: gsheet_search
description: Drive search is executable only in local mode but remains advertised in broker mode.

name: gsheet_clear_range
description: Irreversible value clearing has prose warnings but no annotations; result casing and input vocabulary differ.

name: gsheet_touch_range
description: Read-clear-rewrite recalculation can leave a cleared range and logs original cell values after rewrite failure.

name: GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
description: Optional local OAuth client-secret path; absent from CLI/MCP capability documentation.

name: GOOGLE_TOKEN_FILE
description: Optional local pickle token-cache path; absent from capability documentation and uses unsafe deserialization.

name: GSHEETS_TOKEN_MODE
description: Selects broker mode only when the normalized value is broker; otherwise silently selects local mode.

name: GSHEETS_BROKER_URL
description: Broker base URL; required in broker mode but absent from capability documentation.

name: GSHEETS_BROKER_SESSION_TOKEN
description: Sensitive user-scoped broker session token; required in broker mode and never written to disk.

name: GSHEETS_HEADLESS
description: Disables interactive local OAuth consent when exactly 1; absent from capability documentation.

name: local and per-user broker credentials

runtime.invocation: MCP tool call requiring Google credentials

description: Local disk OAuth and per-user memory-only broker credentials share the helper layer; broker refresh is bounded to one failed request.

name: argument_validation

runtime.help_excerpt: Pydantic Field required validation text with input_value fragment

description: Pre-wrapper validation failure is a raw framework ToolError and does not print a corrected invocation.

name: read_auth_failure

runtime.invocation: MCP read/auth tool call after business failure

description: Read and authentication failures are JSON strings returned as successful MCP results despite some stable typed codes.

name: mutation_partial_failure

runtime.invocation: MCP mutating tool call after uncertain or partial failure

description: Mutation failures are returned as success and omit copy/touch partial state, safe retry guidance, and recovery handles.
